Death Attack.description: This functions identically to the assassin's death attack ability, with the exception that the black flame zealot cannot choose to paralyze a target. If the zealot possesses the death attack feature from a different class (such as assassin), he may combine his black flame zealot levels with those other class levels when determining the saving throw DC of his death attack.

Fateful Stride.description: Starting at 5th level, once per day a black flame zealot may take a single step to teleport through barriers or across distances, functioning as dimension door. His caster level for this effect equals one-half his total character level.

Poison Use.description: Upon reaching 2nd level, a black flame zealot learns to handle poisons without risk of accidentally poisoning himself, identical to the assassin's poison use ability.

Sacred Flame.description: At 7th level and beyond, a black flame zealot can at will cause any single melee weapon he holds to ignite with dark, lethal flames. This grants the weapon the flaming property, adding 1d6 fire damage on each successful hit on top of its normal damage. Additionally, once per day as a free action, the zealot may instead grant a held weapon the flaming burst property for a duration of 1 minute.

Sneak Attack.description: At 3rd, 6th, and 9th level, the black flame zealot gains additional sneak attack damage, functioning as the rogue class feature. Because the zealot already possesses sneak attack from another source (such as rogue levels), the extra damage dice stack with existing sneak attack dice.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: At every even-numbered level in this prestige class, the character receives additional spells per day (and spells known, where applicable) as though he had gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before taking this prestige class. He does not, however, receive any other benefits that class would normally grant (such as improved turning or rebuking undead, bonus metamagic feats, item creation feats, or similar abilities). If the character had multiple divine spellcasting classes prior to entering this prestige class, he must choose which class receives the benefit of each even-numbered level for purposes of spells per day and spells known.
Spells per Day/Spells Known.seedName: Spells per Day/Spells Known (Black Flame Zealot)

Unholy Immolation.description: At 10th level, whenever a creature is slain by the black flame zealot's death attack or sneak attack, its body is instantly and completely consumed by profane fire. Restoring such a creature to life requires true resurrection, a precisely worded wish followed by resurrection, or miracle.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

Zealous Heart.description: A black flame zealot possesses complete immunity to all fear effects, whether mundane or magical in origin. This immunity applies solely to the zealot himself and does not extend any protective benefit to nearby allies.
